mail.subject: {{inviter}} invited you to {{project}} on SiteKeep
mail.body:
Hello {{name}},

{{inviter}} invited you to the project "{{project}}" on SiteKeep, the project's common data environment.

Accept the invitation and choose your password here:
{{url}}

The link works once and is valid until {{expires}}.

If you did not expect this invitation, you can ignore this e-mail; no account is opened without you.
